hints.title: Element Count Condition
hints.text: If the array contains fewer than three numbers, no number can be neither the minimum nor maximum.

hints.title: Prefix Triplet Property
hints.text: With three distinct numbers, the middle number in sorted order is strictly between the smallest and largest.

hints.title: Constant Time Sampling
hints.text: Sort only the first three elements and return the middle value.

hints.title: Triplet Median Code

complexity.notes: Sorting 3 elements executes in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the whole array for min and max takes linear time when checking 3 distinct elements is O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Solves in O(1) time without full array scanning.
